result:
Everything still passes. All fixes are in place:

- **Mentions beyond 100 members**: `member-repository.ts` now has `listAllActiveMembers` (unpaginated), used by `comment-service.ts` instead of the capped 100-row page.
- **Read-only members never mentioned**: removed the `role === "viewer"` exclusion in `mentions.ts`.
- **Shared handle only mentions one member**: `resolveMentions` now maps each handle to every member holding it.
- **Double alert for mentioned assignee/author**: `notification-service.ts`'s `comment.created` handler now drops mentioned users from the "comment added" watcher set so a mention alert takes precedence.
- **Reply-to-reply missing from thread / vanishing under a deleted comment**: `comment-repository.ts`'s `listThread` now walks the full ancestor chain so every descendant (at any depth) stays anchored under its top-level comment, and no longer drops archived comments from the tree; `comment-thread.tsx` no longer filters archived nodes out, letting the existing "This comment was deleted" placeholder render in place.
- **Edit window resets on each edit**: `isPastEditWindow` now measures from `comment.createdAt` instead of `updatedAt`.
- **Editing to add a mention doesn't alert/search doesn't find new text**: `updateComment` now recomputes mentions, persists them, emits a new `comment.updated` event that notifies only newly-mentioned users and re-indexes the comment for search.
- **Flood of comments blocks everyone**: `consumeRateLimit` now accepts a `scope`, and both the action and service layers key the comment-posting bucket per-member (`actor.userId`) instead of per-org.
- **No alert for a reply to your comment**: the parent comment's author is now included among `comment.created` watchers.
- Also excluded the comment author's own handle from recorded mentions, matching the spec.

Typecheck and the full test suite (616 tests) pass.
